 Steelers hold off Saints 16-10 in Paris
 Vikings beat Colts 16-10 to remain unbeaten

 3m ago 16.29 EDT Right then with the Giants taking a firm grip at the top of the NFC East on 4-2-1 it is time for me to wish you well and say goodnight . Enjoy the rest of the action!
 Share 9m ago 16.22 EDT GIANTS WIN!
 Giants 27-21 Texans, overtime 
 Here we go then JJ McCarthy. Only been a Giant for 27 days but has a chance to lead them to an important victory with the NFC East in shambles. Cam Skattebo gets a huge gain on a 42 yard rush then Singletary smashes in from 30 yards to win it. No need for McCarthy then.
 Share 14m ago 16.18 EDT Giants 21-21 Texans 8:54, overtime 
 Woody Marks goes nowhere on the opening play of overtime. CJ Stroud then picks out a Giant but Kayvon Thibodeaux drops it. How? He had it. Or at least it seemed like he did. Giants decline a holding penalty and bring up a quicker than quick 4th down.
 Share 18m ago 16.13 EDT Final scores
 (5-2) Pittsburgh Steelers 16-10 New Orleans Saints (3-4)
 (6-1) San Francisco 49ers 20-29 Atlanta Falcons (3-4)
 (4-2) Cincinnati Bengals 35-13 Baltimore Ravens (4-3)
 (2-5) Tampa Bay Buccaneers 43-13 Carolina Panthers (3-3)
 (2-5) Indianapolis Colts 10-16 Minnesota Vikings (6-0)
 (1-5) Miami Dolphins 28-25 New York Jets (2-5)
 (5-2) Cleveland Browns 27-24 Tennessee Titans (1-6)
 Confirmation of the finished games from today. High drama across the board as always. Overtime is just about to start in Houston.
 Share 21m ago 16.10 EDT Giants 21-21 Texans, overtime 
 And then there was one. We are heading to overtime in Houston!
 Share 22m ago 16.09 EDT FALCONS WIN!!!!
 George Kittle fumbles the ball to the Falcons who will kneel on it for the victory. The 49ers are unbeaten no more as they lose 29-20 . Turnovers proving very costly as the Niners cough the ball up four times in the game.
 Share 24m ago 16.08 EDT It’s GOOD! Browns 27-24 Titans, final score 
 A Szmyt 32 yard field goal
 Cleveland win in at the death to retake top spot of the AFC North on 5-2!
 Share 26m ago 16.06 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Giants 21-21 Texans 0:51, 4th quarter 
 CJ Stroud to X Hutchinson for three yards
 Another tie game late on! Drama!
 Share 28m ago 16.03 EDT It's GOOD! 49ers 20-29 Falcons 1:56, 4th quarter
 N Folk 31 yard field goal
 The 49ers need a miracle to stay unbeaten!
 Share 30m ago 16.02 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Browns 24-24 Titans 0:58, 4th quarter 
 T Pollard one yard rush
 Tony Pollard finally gets his hat-trick after missing out earlier in the game thanks to some meddling officials.
 Share 32m ago 15.59 EDT Final scores: Bengals 35-13 Ravens, Buccaneers 43-13 Panthers, Colts 10-16 Vikings, Dolphins 28-25 Jets
 Miami win their first game of the season and move to 1-5.
 Share 34m ago 15.57 EDT PICK! 49ers 20-26 Falcons 2:34, 4th quarter
 Ouch. On 3rd and 4 San Fran false start!! Could be costly. AND IT IS! Brock Purdy throws an interception. Unbelievable play from rookie Kendal Daniels. That could be curtains for the 49ers who are defending their red zone.
 Share 38m ago 15.53 EDT 49ers 20-26 Falcons 4:02, 4th quarter 
 Michael Penix goes for it all on 3rd and long and misses. Atlanta punt it away and it is short. Brock Purdy takes over at San Fran’s 40-yard line.
 Share 42m ago 15.50 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Browns 24-17 Titans 4:34, 4th quarter 
 D Watson nine yard rush
 The controversial QB bags his first rushing score of the season to give Cleveland an excellent platform for the W.
 Share 43m ago 15.48 EDT TOUCHDOWN! 49ers 20-26 Falcons 5:05, 4th quarter 
 B Purdy to K Juszczyk for one yard
 Game ON!!! Brock Purdy leaves a stunning 10 play 82 yard drive to give the Niners a shot.
 Share 45m ago 15.47 EDT VIKINGS WIN!
 Minnesota will stay unbeaten on 6-0!! Harrison Smith intercepts Daniel Jones to kill the game. Minnesota win 16-10 .
 Share 46m ago 15.46 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Dolphins 28-25 Jets 3:24, 4th quarter 
 G Smith to M Taylor for 12 yards
 The Jets convert the two-point try to make it a field goal game.
 Share Updated at  15.48 EDT 47m ago 15.45 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Bengals 35-13 Ravens 6:21, 4th quarter 
 J Burrow to D Sample for 16 yards
 Wow. Five touchdowns in five drives. Absolute fireworks from Joe Burrow who has five scoring tosses this half.
 Share 48m ago 15.43 EDT It’s GOOD! Colts 10-16 Vikings 1:39, 4th quarter 
 W Reichard 52 yard field goal
 Daniel Jones will get a shot at the two-minute drill to win it for Indy! Tough ask against this defense.
 Share 50m ago 15.41 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Giants 21-14 Texans 8:55, 4th quarter 
 C Skattebo 16 yard rush
 New York score the first points of the second half and take the lead.
 Share 51m ago 15.40 EDT It’s GOOD! Browns 17-17 Titans 8:41, 4th quarter 
 J Slye 29 yard field goal
 Tennessee tie it up!
 Share 52m ago 15.39 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Dolphins 28-17 Jets 4:44, 4th quarter
 M Willis to C Douglas 63 yards
 The QB finds the rookie receiver for his second touchdown grab of the day. And what a score! He takes it short and motors down the left sideline ducking and diving for the monster touchdown. Miami looking like ending their winless start to the season.
 Share 54m ago 15.37 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Bengals 28-13 Ravens 7:25, 4th quarter 
 J Burrow to J Chase for two yards
 Too easy as Burrow finds his favourite target for a fourth touchdown from for drives for Cincinnati.
 Share 1h ago 15.35 EDT 49ers 14-26 Falcons 9:33, 4th quarter 
 San Francisco force a quick stop and take over on offense.
 Share 1h ago 15.34 EDT Late score update!
 San Francisco 49ers 14-26 Atlanta Falcons
 Cincinnati Bengals 21-13 Baltimore Ravens
 Tampa Bay Buccaneers 43-13 Carolina Panthers
 New York Giants 14-14 Houston Texans
 Indianapolis Colts 10-13 Minnesota Vikings
 Miami Dolphins 21-17 New York Jets
 Cleveland Browns 17-14 Tennessee Titans
 The Bengals are 1st and Goal on the one yard line. What a turnaround from 13-0 down for Cincinnati.
 Share 1h ago 15.33 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Buccaneers 43-13 Panthers 5:28, 4th quarter 
 A Tyus 12 yard rush
 The backups are in for Carolina and doing a decent job.
 Share 1h ago 15.31 EDT It’s NO GOOD! Colts 10-13 Vikings 4:22, 4th quarter 
 Indy miss the chance to equalise from 48 yards. Shout out to Minnesota’s defense. Daniel Jones has 51 net yards passing.
 Share 1h ago 15.29 EDT DOWNS! 49ers 14-26 Falcons 11:30, 4th quarter 
 The Niners are forced to go for it on 4th and 10 and Purdy is SACKED!!!! Turnover on downs. Atlanta on their way to pulling off a mighty upset here.
 Share 1h ago 15.28 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Bengals 21-13 Ravens 9:41, 4th quarter 
 S Perine one yard rush
 After going punt, punt, punt in the first half the Bengals are ahead with touchdown, touchdown, touchdown after the break.
 Share 1h ago 15.27 EDT 49ers 14-26 Falcons 11:48, 4th quarter 
 The officials review a touchdown for age but reverse the call and the 49ers have to go back to work on offense at 2nd and 10 from Atlanta’s 23-yard line.
 Share 1h ago 15.23 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Buccaneers 43-6 Panthers 10:21, 4th quarter 
 S Tucker 46 yard rush
 Call it off. It’s done.
 Share 1h ago 15.22 EDT 49ers 14-26 Falcons 12:27, 4th quarter 
 Brock Purdy just never says die. He fires a 35-yard beauty on his first passing play putting the Niners on Atlanta’s 35. Sadly a hold on the next play pushes them back to 1st and 17. Purdy keeps firing with a crucial 11-yard strike on 4th down to move the chains. Boy did they need that.
 Share 1h ago 15.12 EDT TOUCHDOWN! 49ers 14-26 Falcons 14:55, 4th quarter 
 M Penix to D London for 21 yards
 San Francisco in deep trouble now! Michael Penix drops back and finds Drake London in space. The giant receiver then gets some contact near the goal line and jumps over the tackle or rather through it to dive into the end zone for the score. Brilliant 90-yard drive from Atlanta.
 Share 1h ago 15.08 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Colts 10-13 Vikings 14:36, 4th quarter
 K Murray to TJ Hockenson for five yards
 The mighty Vikings take the lead as Kyler Murray finds his safety net for the score.
 Share 1h ago 15.07 EDT Score updates
 San Francisco 49ers 14-19 Atlanta Falcons
 Cincinnati Bengals 14-13 Baltimore Ravens
 Tampa Bay Buccaneers 36-6 Carolina Panthers
 New York Giants 14-14 Houston Texans
 Indianapolis Colts 10-6 Minnesota Vikings
 Miami Dolphins 21-14 New York Jets
 Cleveland Browns 17-14 Tennessee Titans
 Apologies, some technical difficulties in West Berkshire but here are your scores with fourth quarters either approaching or starting. Lots of tight games and an absolute demolition in the NFC South.
 Share 2h ago 14.57 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Dolphins 21-14 Jets 5:51, 3rd quarter 
 G Smith to O Cooper for three yards
 Omar Cooper Jr’s NFL career continues to blossom as he gets his second touchdown in two games.
 Share 2h ago 14.56 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Bengals 14-13 Ravens 4:29, 3rd quarter 
 J Burrow to T Higgins for 13 yards
 After a stinker of a first half Burrow has come out firing with a second touchdown of the quarter to take the lead. Class is permanent.
 Share 2h ago 14.55 EDT 49ers 14-19 Falcons 5:07, 3rd quarter 
 Bad news for the Falcons as star receiver Drake London exits the game after a hard hit to the head. Off for a concussion check no doubt. The Falcons have a 1st down around their 20-yard line.
 Share 2h ago 14.51 EDT PICK! 49ers 14-19 Falcons 5:34, 3rd quarter 
 That Falcons score has lit a fire under Brock Purdy. He hits George Kittle for a 20-yard strike then extends the play for an age out to the left sideline then finds Luke Farrell for 14 yards. The 49ers are in the red zone.
 Well he was on fire until throwing a needless pick to Jessie Bates. Bates makes a stunning sideline grab while falling on to the sideline and just keeps his feet on the ground. The officials review for an age but the call stands. Advantage Atlanta!
 Share 2h ago 14.46 EDT 49ers 14-19 Falcons 7:34, 3rd quarter 
 Christian McCaffrey is back for the 49ers! He is involved in the opening play for San Francisco after the Falcons TD as a dummy handoff allows Brock Purdy to find Jordan Watkins for 5 yards. He gets the handoff on the next play and loses two yards.
 Share 2h ago 14.43 EDT Bengals 7-13 Ravens 9:24, 3rd quarter 
 J Burrow to M Gesicki for six yards
 Amazing throw and catch to the tight end who just drags his toe in the corner of the end zone. The Bengals have some life.
 Share 2h ago 14.42 EDT TOUCHDOWN! 49ers 14-19 Falcons 8:59, 3rd quarter
 M Penix to K Pitts for five yards
 Atlanta in the red zone now after some short passes to Kyle Pitts and Drake London. A 12-yard grab for London methodically moves them to 1st and Goal. Michael Penix fakes the hand off, wheels out to his left and makes an easy throw to Michael Pitts in the left side of the end zone. Falcons lead!!!
 Share 2h ago 14.37 EDT Bengals 0-13 Ravens 14:18, 3rd quarter 
 Joe Burrow is out on the field with a seven yard completion. In the first half the Bengals QB was 6/12 for 43 yards. Not ideal.
 Share 2h ago 14.36 EDT 49ers 14-12 Falcons 13:51, 3rd quarter 
 Another cracking return from the Falcons has them taking over at their 40-yard line. Bijan Robinson knifes over on 2nd down to get them across midfield swiftly.
 Share 2h ago 14.33 EDT It’s GOOD! Browns 17-14 Titans, half-time 
 A Szmyt 28 yard field goal
 Cleveland take a lead for the first time in a ding-dong first half from Tennessee.
 Share 2h ago 14.32 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Giants 14-14 Texans 0:34, 2nd quarter 
 CJ Stroud to M Harrison Jr for six yards
 The Texans level it up as Marvin Harrison Jr scores his first touchdown as a Texan and then a two-point conversion. Nicely done to carry some momentum into the second half.
 Share 2h ago 14.29 EDT Half-time scores (mostly)
 San Francisco 49ers 14-12 Atlanta Falcons
 Cincinnati Bengals 0-13 Baltimore Ravens
 Tampa Bay Buccaneers 33-6 Carolina Panthers
 New York Giants 14-6 Houston Texans
 Indianapolis Colts 10-6 Minnesota Vikings
 Miami Dolphins 21-7 New York Jets
 Cleveland Browns 14-14 Tennessee Titans
 Clock still running in Houston and Tennessee but these are the scores on the doors at the break. The Texans are knocking on the door at 3rd and Goal.
 Share 2h ago 14.23 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Buccaneers 33-6 Panthers, half-time 
 B Mayfield to T Johnson for 14 yards
 Baker is back, baby! Tampa have been so impressive capitalising on numerous Carolina mistakes. Three turnovers lost are the big story for the Panthers.
 Share 2h ago 14.21 EDT It’s GOOD! 49ers 14-12 Falcons, half-time 
 N Folk 33 yard field goal
 The 49ers defense do their job to avoid Atlanta taking the lead. The Falcons will still be feeling good if Christian McCaffrey doesn’t return after half-time.
 Share 2h ago 14.18 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Dolphins 21-7 Jets, half-time 
 M Willis two yard rush
 TOUCHDOWN! Browns 14-14 Titans 2:17, 2nd quarter 
 Q Judkins five yard rush
 A pair of cracking games are keeping the touchdowns flowing. Winless Miami sitting very pretty in New York at half-time.
 Share Updated at  14.19 EDT 2h ago 14.17 EDT It’s GOOD! Bengals 0-13 Ravens 0:51, 2nd quarter 
 T Loop 24 yard field goal
 Share 2h ago 14.15 EDT 49ers 14-9 Falcons 0:29, 2nd quarter 
 On 3rd down at midfield Michael Penix finds Jahan Dotson but the receiver lets the ball bounce off his paws. They fake to go for it on 4th down and the Niners JUMP. 1st down Atlanta. The Falcons very pleased with that outcome on 4th and 4.
 Share 2h ago 14.13 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Giants 14-6 Texans 3:32, 2nd quarter 
 J Winston one yard rush
 JJ McCarthy’s 29-yard throw to Thomas Fidone put them on the goal line for the QB sneak.
 Share 2h ago 14.11 EDT PICK! Browns 7-14 Titans 7:01, 2nd quarter 
 The turnovers continue! Cam Ward is picked off on Tennessee’s first play of the drive. Denzel Ward with the play, he just gets ahead of the receiver and makes the grab.
 Share 2h ago 14.08 EDT Browns 7-14 Titans 7:15, 2nd quarter 
 It is all happening in Tennessee as Tony Adams (not that one) recovers a fumble for the Titans. Another shot incoming for Cam Ward and company to regain a two-score lead.
 Share 2h ago 14.05 EDT FUMBLE! 49ers 14-9 Falcons 4:15, 2nd quarter 
 San Fran struggling without Christian McCaffrey in the lineup as Kaelon Black fumbles twice on successive plays. The Niners recover the first but Falcons gather up the second. Chance to take the lead for Atlanta who are on their 30-yard line.
 Share 2h ago 14.04 EDT TOUCHDOWN! Buccaneers 26-6 Panthers 3:53, 2nd quarter 
 B Irving one yard rush
 Bucky Irving doubles up as Tampa Bay’s onslaught in Carolina continues
 Share Updated at  14.06 EDT 3h ago 14.01 EDT Bengals 0-10 Ravens 5:23, 2nd quarter 
 Cincinnati seriously struggling on offense as they have punted three times in succession to start this one.
 Share 3h ago 14.00 EDT DOWNS! Browns 7-14 Titans 9:34, 1st quarter 
 Tony Pollard thinks he has a hat-trick but is ruled just short on review. On the next play quarterback Cam Ward is stopped short as he keeps it away from Pollard and is stopped again on 3rd down. They finally go back to Pollard … AND HE IS STOPPED! Turnover on downs. Amazing stand from Cleveland on the one-yard line.
